name: Semester 1
tagline: Foundations of Communication, Speech Anatomy, Language Expression & Assessment

subjects.title: Personality Development and Communication Skills
subjects.description: Self-confidence, voice modulation, interpersonal communication, and active listening.

subjects.title: Communication Theories
subjects.description: Classical and modern communication models, encoding, decoding, and feedback mechanisms.

subjects.title: Expressionism of the Language
subjects.description: Emotional tonality, syntax structure, and conveying communicative intent.

subjects.title: Developing Language Oral and Written Skills
subjects.description: Pronunciation clarity, syntactic sentence construction, and structured writing.

subjects.title: Command Over Targeted Language
subjects.description: Grammatical mastery, idiomatic comprehension, and fluency in primary language.

subjects.title: Language Interpreting
subjects.description: Real-time message interpretation, cross-lingual accuracy, and assistive conversion.

subjects.title: Communication, Language and Speech
subjects.description: Triad connecting cognition, acoustic speech generation, and listener comprehension.

subjects.title: Anatomy and Physiology of the Speech Mechanism
subjects.description: Respiratory apparatus, laryngeal vocal folds, resonation, and articulators.

subjects.title: Internal Assessment
subjects.description: Continuous coursework evaluation, quizzes, presentations, and periodic midterm reviews.

name: Semester 2
tagline: Audiology, Indian Sign Language (ISL), Speech Pathology & Rehabilitation

subjects.title: Oral Expression of the Language
subjects.description: Spoken fluency, pronunciation accuracy, pitch variation, and conversational spontaneity.

subjects.title: Indian Sign Language (ISL) as a Language
subjects.description: ISL grammar, manual alphabet finger-spelling, facial expressions, and spatial syntax.

subjects.title: Communicative English and Computer Fundamentals
subjects.description: Computer literacy, documentation processing, and English comprehension for educational setups.

subjects.title: Audiology (Sound and Hearing)
subjects.description: Sound physics, ear anatomy, decibel calibration, and introductory audiometric assessments.

subjects.title: Speech and Language Pathology
subjects.description: Introduction to speech variations, voice characteristics, and rehabilitation concepts.

subjects.title: Community-Based Rehabilitation
subjects.description: Inclusive education, community awareness, and support systems for diverse individuals.

subjects.title: Legal Language and Legal Writing
subjects.description: Disability rights legislation, documentation norms, record keeping, and ethical standards.

subjects.title: Internal Assessment and Project
subjects.description: Coursework portfolio, project assignment submission, and internal appraisals.

subjects.title: Viva
subjects.description: Summative oral examination assessing comprehensive understanding of DHLS fundamentals.
